options.content:
**Dashboard 3 of 4 (Section 12.4).** AML-pack-specific activity: `ofac-sanctions` + `transaction-graph` only (Phase 3 Days 11-14).

Backed by `agg_aml_pack_daily`. `sanctions_matches` is an illustrative ~35% placeholder rate, not a measured confidence score -- no real match-confidence field exists on synthetic rows the way Day 11's real rapidfuzz score does. Fixed 2026-07-06 to 2026-08-03 window, same as every other dashboard here.

panels.title: OFAC call volume + illustrative sanctions match rate

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS time, 'OFAC calls' AS metric, ofac_calls AS value
        FROM agg_aml_pack_daily WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT day, 'Sanctions matches (illustrative)', sanctions_matches
        FROM agg_aml_pack_daily WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        ORDER BY time

SELECT day AS time, transaction_graph_calls AS value
        FROM agg_aml_pack_daily
        WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        ORDER BY day

SELECT sum(structuring_alerts) AS value
        FROM agg_aml_pack_daily
        WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)

SELECT 'Denied' AS metric, sum(mark_investigated_denied) AS value
        FROM agg_aml_pack_daily WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'HITL-approved', sum(mark_investigated_approved)
        FROM agg_aml_pack_daily WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Auto-passed (synthetic-only, see how-to-read)', sum(mark_investigated_auto_passed)
        FROM agg_aml_pack_daily WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)

options.content: **Named gap, not populated.** Agent A1's live session risk score (`interpose.control_plane.agents.policy_evaluator`) is written to an ephemeral Redis hash (`interpose:session:{id}`), not persisted anywhere historical -- there's nothing for `aggregate_telemetry` to read a distribution from. Persisting a risk-score snapshot per decision (not just the live Redis value) would be needed before this panel could show real data; named here rather than faked.
